root_cause_label: Hallucinated Zork navigation sequences and unknown game map
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent fabricated a nonsense speedrun script of thousands of repeated cardinal-direction commands (steps 8-10) with no knowledge of the actual Zork I map, then never successfully entered the house or navigated to the endgame despite 50 steps of attempts.
t_err_evidence: cat > /app/zork_speedrun.txt with meaningless e/s/w loops committed as speedrun script
t_commit_evidence: From step 8 onward the agent exclusively pursues scripted-command-file approaches derived from its hallucinated Zork knowledge. Even after discovering in step 21 that 'open window' fails ('You can't see any window here!'), it only tweaks minor details and never adopts a fundamentally correct navigation strategy, making failure irrecoverable within the budget.
t_surface_evidence: You can't see any window here! You can't see any trapdoor here!
trigger_explanation: The agent lacks knowledge of the actual Zork I map layout and valid speedrun commands. Instead of exploring the game interactively to learn the map, it generates thousands of hallucinated cardinal-direction sequences (e/w/s/n loops), then attempts variations of a 'n n d open window enter' path that does not correctly reach the kitchen window (which requires going around to the back of the house via a specific route).
forewarning_evidence: echo 'help' | ./frotz zork1.z5 | head -20 produced empty output
